name: bge-small-rrf-v3
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Self-supervised retrieval finetune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (MNRL, 39,852 emitted triples over a 60,000 target, 2 epochs, lr 3e-6, batch 32, ~15 min on an A100) trained on hard negatives mined from RRF disagreement between a vector index and full-text search. Same 384 dims and 33M params as the base. Strong same-table evidence: the card prints Base, v2 and v3 columns side by side on a full 5-dataset BEIR cut, all re-evaluated under one production RRF hybrid pipeline, with macro nDCG@10 0.6118 -> 0.6405. Read it with the card's own caveats: ArguAna is a loss (0.7686 base vs 0.7540 v3), and NFCorpus beats the base but regresses against predecessor v2 (0.4325 -> 0.3927). SciDocs is +0.006 and the card calls that within noise. Licence MIT, repo created 2026-04-19.

benchmarks.name: BEIR SciFact nDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Absolute NDCG@10 vs BM25, ColBERTv2, and previous releases', column Base 0.9082 vs v3 0.9361. Full 5-dataset BEIR cut through vstash's production pipeline (RRF hybrid + adaptive weights + doc-level dedup, top-100 candidate pool); base and both releases re-evaluated under the same pipeline.

benchmarks.name: BEIR FiQA nDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Same table: base 0.6509 vs v3 0.7506 (+0.097, the largest win). Same RRF hybrid pipeline.

benchmarks.name: BEIR SciDocs nDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Same table: base 0.3637 vs v3 0.3693. The card itself calls the v3-vs-v2 gap 'within noise' on this dataset; the base gap is +0.006.

benchmarks.name: BEIR NFCorpus nDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Same table: base 0.3674 vs v3 0.3927. Worth reading with the card's own caveat: predecessor v2 scored 0.4325 here, so v3 regresses vs v2 while still beating the base.

benchmarks.name: BEIR ArguAna nDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Same table, a LOSS recorded as measured: base 0.7686 vs v3 0.7540 (-0.015). v2 of this model also lost here (0.7579).

benchmarks.name: BEIR macro nDCG@10 (5 datasets)
benchmarks.config: Same table 'macro' row: base 0.6118 vs v3 0.6405. The promotion criterion the card's own pipeline uses ('promote the candidate only if macro NDCG@10 exceeds the base').
